basis.platform: win32-x64, Node 26, structural derivation over the working tree
basis.note: Behavioral characterization binds existing discriminating tests (cargo nextest filters) to every ARH1 hotspot responsibility and to every cutover route a successor narrows. No new test-governance framework is introduced: the pins extend the existing architecture-health harness, and the wall-clock cost of the pinned lanes is owned by the complexity-measurements product, never by this one.

deletion.rationale: The .gitignore-only placeholder had no package.json, no sources, no literal pnpm-workspace.yaml entry (covered only by the packages/* glob) and no importer; populating it would invent a package with no consumer. ARH1-CUT-1 decided physical deletion; ARH2 executes it.
deletion.consumerPopulation: empty by measurement: no importer of packages/core existed at deletion time (ARH1-CUT-1 evidence); an empty deletion-set consumer population, not a silent one

pins.behavior: submission dedup merges identity and upgrades priority; readiness order is the priority lane order; an older generation is dropped as stale
the driver owns admission and ordering policy: a ready node enters its priority-class lane, and a pre-dispatch dedup that adds a dependency removes the ready token from the lane
cancellation latches are one-shot and idempotent across clones
symbolic flow-return calls resolve complete; this-calls read the receiver member; an empty cycle stays return-only
flow products are selected and scoped: script-setup functions serve under the instance owner only, Svelte script functions under the instance owner, not the module owner
build/admission cycle-gates recursion: productive tree recursion continues, generic mutual recursion stops
the store assembles through dispatch transactions: a staged session is deposit-inactive and commits exactly once; abandonment respects the commit boundary
the memo table interns stable identities: interning returns unique stable ids, dedups structural values across contexts, and resolve-decl memo keys discriminate the top-level owner
the memo table interns stable identities: interning returns unique stable ids, dedups structural values across contexts, and resolve-decl memo keys discriminate the top-level owner
query keys bind deterministically: equal-prefix literals order by exact key and primitive tags are fixed independent of intern order
slice content lowers without rescans: nested descriptors defer mutable capture annotation content and occurrence classification never rescans hoisted alias groups
slice publication admission gates on the budget: the flow product budget boundary is exact and never warm

incarnation identity rejects pre-remove source submission and late admission, lifecycle removal/reset/cancellation drain work and capacity and leave no restart history, the scheduler-minted source witness rejects delayed external publication and cleanup across remove/reset while successor versions never alias the retired node, and deferred blockers are replaced, not appended

ac3.note: ARH2 touches no production state/query/map boundary: the only production mutation is deleting the packages/core placeholder, which holds no state, and the delivered code is the characterization/measurement harness itself. The concerns below therefore bind the EXISTING evidence that already pins each concern for the characterized boundaries, so a later narrowing that regresses one fails a named test today.

concerns.note: generation supersession is the incremental/fresh seam of scheduler admission
remove-and-readd is the edit/revert seam of the scheduler bookkeeping
query-memo cancellation and wait-cycle detection, not scheduler latches alone
a different outer source snapshot is rejected at selection time

concerns.concern: deterministic ordering under perturbed discovery or scheduling
concerns.note: key order is exact-key-determined regardless of interning order

ac4Rationale: ARH2's public delivery is the architecture-health harness itself: the pinned lanes are runnable with the exact recorded commands, and this product is the reference a contributor uses to reproduce them. The VIM/DX capability mapping and host/profile evidence table for the RETAINED surfaces are DOC2's obligation and the executable examples/reference performance recipe belongs to the web performance node; ARH2 claims neither.
ac5Rationale: No new latency/work/allocation/RSS budget is created here. The complexity-measurements product binds the four measurement dimensions to the existing ratified performance methodology (performance-gates.toml) and records only deterministically re-derivable structural counts; wall-clock numbers stay in gate receipts, never in committed products.
emptyDeletionSetRationale: not-applicable-non-empty: the deletion set is packages/core (ARH0-DEBT-1 decided by ARH1-CUT-1, executed here with the same-change ARH0 population refresh)
